caption: The drawing shows a circular, shallow dish with a wide rim, depicted in grayscale pencil or graphite on an off-white background. Attached to the top of the dish is an ornate, symmetrical handle with openwork curves and a small circular hole at its peak, suggesting it might be used for hanging. The area just below the handle features what appears to be an inscribed monogram or initials. In the bottom left corner of the page, there is a small line drawing illustrating the side profile of the dish, showing it to have a rounded bottom and a gently outward-flaring rim, with a small horizontal handle or extension. The artist’s name, "Amelia Tuccio," is written in the lower right corner of the drawing. The composition is centered, with the main dish and handle occupying most of the page, and the colors throughout are monochromatic shades of gray.
title: Silver Porringer
